definition.en: Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) are business entities owned, managed, and controlled by the government to serve public interest and promote economic development.
definition.hi: Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) are business entities owned, managed, and controlled by the government to serve public interest and promote economic development.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding PSEs is crucial for GS-3 as they form the backbone of India's industrial infrastructure and public service delivery. Questions often focus on their classification, disinvestment policies, and their role in achieving socio-economic objectives.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding PSEs is crucial for GS-3 as they form the backbone of India's industrial infrastructure and public service delivery. Questions often focus on their classification, disinvestment policies, and their role in achieving socio-economic objectives.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the classification of PSEs based on ownership and operational autonomy.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the classification of PSEs based on ownership and operational autonomy.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of PSEs in the Indian economy and their contribution to infrastructure development.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of PSEs in the Indian economy and their contribution to infrastructure development.
